items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: But you did some things that Lips Page sang on, with Artie.

ctx.x: Well, let's see that didn't last too long because he went in the Army -- he went in the Navy.
: But you did some things that Lips Page sang on, with Artie.

With Artie. "Blues in the Night," Take Your Shoes Off, Baby. Several other things. Johnny Guarnieri was in the band then. Georgie Auld. Les Robinson. Fine lead player. Jack Jenney, and his wife sang. She sang This Time The Dream's On Me-" That was recorded.
